how_to_read: Do the 36 sessions in order. Train no more than 3 sessions in any 7 days, and ideally no more than 2 days in a row.
If 14 or more days pass between sessions, repeat your last session before moving on.
Two numbers joined by / read as him/her: Goblet Squats (35/25) means he uses the 35 lb kettlebell and she uses the 25.
No set goes past technical failure. Technical failure is when your form breaks down and you have a sloppy rep.

Strength: one person works through the full set while the other rests, then switch. Conditioning: each piece says where each of you starts or when to switch, so you never need the same equipment at the same time.
From Session 13, some lifts use percentages. Enter your test sets on the Working Weights tab and it shows each weight.
Cooldown at the end of each session: 3:00-5:00 walk, then lightly stretch the muscles trained.

pieces.notes: Choose dumbbells you could press about 13 times. If the tenth rep moves as fast as the first, go up in weight next set. Walk your feet forward on the TRX to make rows harder or back to make them easier.

pieces.notes: Deadlift the bar off the floor to stand tall. Start each rep by pushing your hips back with soft knees, and lower to just below the knee or until your back starts to round, whichever comes first. On the squat jumps, jump for height, land softly, and reset between reps.
